cases.evidence: An open or unpaid checkout leaves the existing plan unchanged. Tenant-specific free quota and JodiUSA end-to-end configuration still need acceptance.

Actual first monthly payment activates the matching plan; renewal records a separate paid local invoice; refund accounting preserves subscription access until explicit cancellation. Complete paid feature/tenant grant coverage remains open, including the proposed JodiUSA all-features free exception.
Commerce stock overflow is denied. Subscription feature quotas and concurrent limits remain unverified; inventory stock is not a substitute.
Caller-selected dummy/test/paypal payment providers are refused and cross-tenant products/content are rejected. All tenant paid-feature gates need browser/API acceptance.

Real hosted monthly subscription paid at existing catalog amount; test clock generated a paid monthly renewal. Real annual checkout uses yearly recurring interval and unpaid annual checkout grants nothing. Monthly/annual price mapping regressions pass. Reduced-route synthetic environment, Standard Checkout test override and unverified browser return/full tenant journey prevent full category approval.

Actual Stripe CLI deliveries reconcile checkout, invoice.paid, partial/full charge.refunded and subscription lifecycle events. SDK decimal serialization fixed; signature failure, malformed verification and duplicate/concurrent refund regressions pass. No registered staging HTTPS callback or full concurrent cross-event/out-of-order lifecycle acceptance; previous signature checks retained.

Real provider cancel-at-period-end is recorded while retaining current paid access; explicit cancellation deactivates the local subscription. PostgreSQL tests cover delayed payment after cancellation and stale updates. Natural period-end expiry and user-facing cancellation journey remain unverified.

Real initial-payment partial/full refunds update invoice state and exact negative ledger totals. Renewal refund binds only to its own invoice; refunds do not implicitly cancel recurring access. PostgreSQL concurrent duplicate/partial/full refund tests and stale/refund-before-checkout tests pass. Pending/failed provider refund recovery and exhaustive cross-event ordering remain open.

products.note: Jodibana separate product candidate: 90/90 PostgreSQL tests pass, including concurrent refunds. Actual monthly subscription and test-clock renewal, partial/full refunds, renewal-specific refund binding and cancellation pass (8/8 lifecycle assertions); annual checkout uses yearly interval and unpaid activation is denied. Both prior measured failures are fixed in staging. Refunds reconcile money without automatically canceling subscriptions. Production unchanged. Full tenant/auth journey, usage tiers, Managed Payments default, complete out-of-order lifecycle and release prerequisites remain open. JodiUSA all-feature/no-charge entitlement is a separately proposed tenant exception requiring tests; no live pricing or entitlement change.
